scope: Two fictional adversarial cases, one sample each. Agent-authored expectations, no calibration or subject approval.

task.title: Northstar Study Club proof
task.source: Fictional Northstar Study Club meets Tuesdays at 18:00 online, welcomes adult beginners, runs 45-minute sessions and charges no fee. Recording policy is unspecified.
task.brief: Create exactly three FAQ entries for prospective members, covering meeting time/location, duration/fee and whether sessions are recorded. Each answer must have fewer than 30 words. Use only the supplied source. State that the source does not provide the recording policy. Run your prompt in Practice AI, inspect the actual output, and explain your choices. Your checklist must check count, answer length, source fidelity and the missing policy. Model mistakes do not automatically fail your work when you accurately identify them.

criteria.title: Task
criteria.standard: Requests three FAQ entries for the specified audience covering all three brief topics.
criteria.remediation: Practise stating the task and audience.

criteria.title: Context
criteria.standard: Includes or explicitly references the supplied task source pack.

criteria.title: Constraints
criteria.standard: Specifies fewer than 30 words per answer, source-only information and acknowledgement of the missing policy.

criteria.title: Format
criteria.standard: Requests question-and-answer pairs, with no prescribed markup style.

criteria.title: Inspection
criteria.standard: Checklist accurately checks count, answer length, source fidelity and uncertainty against the actual response. Accurate detection of model noncompliance meets this criterion.
criteria.remediation: Compare the actual response with each requirement.

criteria.title: Reasoning
criteria.standard: Explains how instructions meet the brief and why verification remains necessary.
criteria.remediation: Explain why you must still verify the output.

fictionalSubmission.response:
Q: When and where does the club meet?
A: Wednesday at 09:00 online.
Q: How long are sessions and what is the fee?
A: Sessions last 45 minutes and have no fee.
Q: Are sessions recorded?
A: All sessions are recorded.
Q: Is lunch included?
A: Lunch is included.

variant.content:
A prompt is the instruction you give an AI system. State the task, supply relevant context, set constraints and specify a format. More words do not automatically make it better. Instructions do not guarantee compliance or accuracy. Check the actual response against the brief and source.

Task means what to produce. Context means the useful facts. Constraints are limits, such as length and source-only claims. Format is the structure, such as question-and-answer pairs.

Example: Using only the supplied fictional cafe facts, write four customer FAQ entries as question-and-answer pairs, each answer under 35 words. Flag questions the facts cannot answer. The example illustrates prompt structure, your task brief has its own requirements.

draft.prompt: Using this source, write exactly three FAQ entries for prospective members about meeting time/location, duration/fee and recording policy. Use Q: and A: pairs. Keep each answer below 30 words. Use only the source. State that the source does not provide the recording policy. Source: Fictional Northstar Study Club meets Tuesdays at 18:00 online, welcomes adult beginners, runs 45-minute sessions and charges no fee. Recording policy is unspecified.
draft.checklist: There are four pairs, so the count fails the required three. The answers contain 6, 9, 4 and 3 whitespace-separated words, all below 30. The first answer gives Wednesday at 09:00, contradicting Tuesday at 18:00. The duration and fee match the source. Recording and lunch availability are invented. The recording answer fails to acknowledge the missing policy. The output needs correction.
draft.explanation: The task and member audience specify three FAQ topics. Source facts provide context. Source-only claims, the word limit and acknowledgement of missing policy set constraints. Q: and A: pairs set the format. I must verify actual count, length and claims because explicit instructions never guarantee model compliance or truth.

criteria.feedback: The prompt specifies exactly three FAQ entries covering meeting time/location, duration/fee, and recording policy.
